recognize_zh: 高倍下是一片單調的小至中型細胞，核多呈有稜角、扭曲或有裂溝的形狀（centrocyte），僅偶見核較大、染色質較開放的 centroblast；左側可見殘存的腺上皮，符合低級別濾泡性淋巴瘤浸潤十二指腸黏膜。
features: Monotonous population of small to medium lymphoid cells
Predominantly angulated, elongated, and cleaved nuclei (centrocytes) with dense chromatin
Only occasional larger cells with vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli (centroblasts)
Scant pale cytoplasm; no plasmacytic or monocytoid differentiation
Residual glandular epithelium at the left edge; no tingible body macrophages seen
describe_en: High-power view of the duodenal biopsy shows a monotonous infiltrate of small to medium lymphoid cells with scant cytoplasm. Most cells have angulated, elongated, or cleaved nuclei with condensed chromatin, consistent with centrocytes, while larger centroblasts with vesicular chromatin are infrequent. Tingible body macrophages, mitotic activity, and sheets of large cells are not appreciated, and residual glandular epithelium is present at the edge. In conjunction with a CD10+/BCL6+/BCL2+ immunophenotype, findings are consistent with low-grade (duodenal-type) follicular lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers contain a mixture of centroblasts and centrocytes with tingible body macrophages and frequent mitoses, and are BCL2 negative.
Mantle cell lymphoma cells have slightly irregular but less angulated nuclei, lack centroblasts, and are cyclin D1+/CD5+ rather than CD10+.
MALT lymphoma cells have more cytoplasm (monocytoid), plasmacytic differentiation, and lymphoepithelial lesions, and are CD10/BCL6 negative.
DLBCL is composed of sheets of large cells (centroblasts or immunoblasts), unlike the predominantly small cleaved cells here.
